text:
katie: follow-up from the postmortem \u2014 observed repeated cross-region DNS retries + connection resets when route updates coincided with high MTU paths. looks like a routing-label mismatch + stale conntrack entries. want owners and short timeline.
omar: agree. root cause: controller rolled new routes without propagating `sni_tag` and `route_hash` to some edge pools; clients retried, LB hit conntrack limits, and TLS handshakes retried. pcap: https://redwood.internal/forensics/1788881234
riyad: impact: elevated retry rates in us-east and eu-central, healthcheck flaps, ~8% increased p99 latency. pattern seen before but different trigger (this time a rollout overlap).
jen: proposed immediate actions: 1) emergency routing revert to last-good for affected pools (owner: @omar, target: 4h). 2) conntrack table cleanup + bump transient conntrack limit on hot edges (owner: @jen, target: 6h). 3) short-term LB cfg to prefer TCP for oversized DNS responses where supported (owner: @riyad, target: 72h). 4) long-term: controller preflight that rejects route updates missing critical labels; add rollout gating test. owner: platform-sre. ETA: 2w.
omar: opened ticket NET-5010 for rollback, command ready: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/route-controller -n routing --to-revision=42`
jen: running conntrack purge on eu-central canary: `conntrack -F --orig-port-dst=53` and bumped conntrack limit via `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` on two canaries. monitoring CPU and table size.
ops-bot: deploy: rollback started by omar at 2025-11-07T02:18:12Z. status: rolling(3/3)
riyad: probe update planned: synthetic DNS queries with large UDP payloads and forced TCP fallback checks. snippet on PR: https://git.redwood/probes/457. will promote after 24h.
omar: rollback completed, route labels restored. observability: retry rate back to baseline in 18m.
jen: conntrack purge reduced stale entries by 94% on canary nodes, CPU stable. promoting change to region.
platform-sre: opened NET-5021 for controller validation PR, initial tests pass locally. adding e2e for cross-region propagation. ETA 14 days.
katie: owner summary for tracking: omar (rollback, 4h), jen (conntrack cleanup + limits, 6h), riyad (tcp-fallback plan + probes, 72h), platform-sre (controller preflight + e2e, 14d). we'll run weekly checks on the networking trendboard and reconvene if metrics regress. please post short updates here as you hit milestones.
